source: Explicit synthetic fixtures only; original v15 source is absent.
implemented: Strict UTF-8 bounded JSON tokenization before JSON.parse; duplicate decoded keys, malformed surrogates, NUL, negative zero and unsafe integers rejected
Versioned deterministic UTF-16 key-sorted canonical JSON and matching browser/server SHA-256 projections
Frozen snapshot/concept/asset hashes and cross-reference validation; historical optional-field absence retained
Bounded ZIP central/local entries, paths, CRC, expansion, hashes and MIME validation; no archive database writes or live QR reassignment
Original-ID package roundtrip; local fonts and KaTeX bundle; mapping CSV formula neutralization
Exact concept blank picks with frozen bank labels, schema reuse, form/section/order/count validation and givenCase recall rejection; no pick in URL or legacy sheet code
Shared measured A4 React/HTML layout, parity/overflow failures, exact two-page unit intro, student/answer/spread exports
Student answer removal before render model; teacher-only inert JSON archive HTML; single-file offline local assets
Trusted intercepted local Chromium/PDFjs resources; every final PDF QR decoded from raster pixels and matched to reserved target URL
Bounded resumable chunk adapters, chunk hash/order verification, verified merged/spread artifacts and volume fallback
Frozen answer placement adapter and page references; first-only inline SVG extraction; nullable choice and dimension mapping through legacy print

integration.root: Wire print-check entry and student/auth/snapshot reader paths; final root application verification remains coordinator-owned.
integration.claude: Persist immutable chunk PDFs and pages/pageMap/qrPlacements/artifactHash/nextPhysicalPageIndex; use matching student frozenPages for answers; finalize only after final artifact QR checks.
integration.grok: Use TextbookPaper/TextbookSpread with createTextbookRenderModel and measured preview; provide authorized asset URLs and reserved-URL QR PNG resources.
integration.setupLockDelta: Preserved original incidental setup delta in tmp/textbook/setup-lock.patch before root dependency merge; package files remain root-owned.

limitations: Physical printer alignment, phone scans, live login return and assigned video playback require coordinator-owned integrated app and real assigned data.
Original v15 is unavailable; no source conversion or visual-fidelity/completeness claim is made.
An indivisible block or answer exceeding its measured page area fails with a location-specific issue; content is never silently removed or scaled to fit.
Chunks permit at most eight contiguous sections and 600 measured blocks; continued-section chains must stay together.
